parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a
retried request safe. The service always runs on Postgres, so it is
required on every deployment and answered with 400
`idempotency-key-required` when absent; a replay with the same key and
the same request (method, path and body) returns the original response
with the header `Idempotency-Replayed: true` when that answer was a
success or a refusal that is final for the request, while the same key
with a different request is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. A refusal that
depends on state that can change (422 `policy-not-declared`,
`origin-unknown`, `station-position-unknown`) and every 5xx are not
stored: the key is released, the same request under the same key
executes again and a different body under it is a new request.
